subject: nova-bennet
label: She actually died
to: A description. She died inside and came back
note:
Proclaimed dead, with paperwork and a hearse. One of the nurses — an actual one, unlike the rest — took pity and smuggled her body out, and raised her. Somewhere between the hearse and that house the universe said NAH, WE GOT PLANS FOR THIS ONE and brought her back. THE SECOND SUNRISE is an accounting.

Her only dream was to run. Bryn saw the limp years later and quietly built a PULLEY PLATFORM into the apartment and shop so Nova could move between floors under her own power — so she would not have to be alone. Sera mentioned Marianne could probably fix it. Nova asked Bryn to drive her. She still limped afterward, seven years of habit, until Livi said RUN, NOVA, WE'LL BE HERE IN CASE. She beat Rae in every race, then ran to Fairbrooks University, through the field, past the bleachers, into cheer practice, and into Violet.
